A '''bloodsnake''' is a large brown snake of the [[Aiel Waste]].

==Description==
A bloodsnake can be as thick as a man's forearm and three paces in length. Its bite turns the blood of its victim to jelly in minutes. A widely known [[Wise One]] named [[Mora (Wise One)|Mora]] died in this way at age 300.{{ref/book|6|15}}

The [[Aiel]] eat the meat of a bloodsnake, cooked in such dishes as a spicy stew of dried peppers and beans containing chunks of the bloodsnake's nearly white meat and served with a flat pale bread.{{ref/book|5|21}}
